data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

I’m Andrew, founder of Local Ledger, an independent research publisher that uses public records only and is never issuer-paid.

Thompson Davis & Co.’s most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in SMID, ESOA, and SHIM.

On October 8, 2026, SHIM entered into a material definitive agreement in an 8-K Item 1.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1887944/000119312526418076/shim-20261002.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Andrew

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
